statement: To place a legal hold on customer data: (1) legal counsel submits a hold request identifying the affected accounts and matter, (2) the privacy office suspends the standard retention timer for those accounts within one business day, (3) the hold is logged with a start date and no end date until counsel issues a release.

confidence.rationale: Directly stated in the governing data retention policy document, section 5.1.

evidence.excerpt: Legal holds are initiated by counsel, applied by the privacy office within one business day, and remain in effect until counsel issues a written release.

conditions: an active legal matter naming the affected accounts

mandatory_qualifications: hold remains until counsel issues a release
evaluation_rules: answers describing the retention timer must note that a legal hold suspends it
